sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion that includes <OneTimeUse/> using the same Assertion/@ID twice. Second submission should be rejected if OneTimeUse is enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion with <OneTimeUse/> and identical Assertion/@ID; OneTimeUse anti-replay not enforced.

sequence_description: Test SAML <OneTimeUse/> anti-replay across distinct SP-initiated sessions: submit the same Assertion/@ID twice with OneTimeUse present, but with a fresh OIDC authorize initiation between submissions to simulate a new session context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion with <OneTimeUse/> (second submission should be rejected).

sequence_description: Test whether SAML assertion ID replay detection survives explicit logout: login with a fixed Assertion/@ID, logout, then replay the same Assertion/@ID again.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_fixedid_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_fixedid_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion ID after logout; assertion ID replay cache may be missing or incorrectly scoped.

sequence_description: Test time-bound enforcement under configuration change + re-auth: perform a control SAML login, then change application session/token expiry settings, then attempt an expired SAML assertion login (NotOnOrAfter in the past).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); assertion freshness not enforced.

sequence_description: Login via SAML with a fixed Assertion/@ID, then tighten application expiry settings and attempt to replay the same Assertion/@ID. Expected: replay is rejected regardless of app expiry changes; acceptance suggests replay cache is absent or reset by config changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_after_cfg_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_after_cfg_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed Assertion/@ID after application config change; replay cache may be missing or reset, violating anti-replay.

sequence_description: Test provider/session binding by initiating an OIDC auth session and then attempting to complete it with a SAMLResponse that claims a different IdP entity (Issuer) than the configured provider metadata. If the flow is coherent, the mismatched Issuer should be rejected and not create a session.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_issuer_mismatch_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_issuer_mismatch_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: Casdoor accepted a SAMLResponse with an Issuer/IdP entity that does not match the provider context/metadata.

sequence_description: Test whether enabling MFA for a user affects all authentication paths coherently. First enable MFA for victim, then attempt password login (expected to be blocked/challenged). Then attempt SAML login for the same principal attributes; if SAML succeeds while password is blocked, MFA enforcement may be skipped on the SAML path (flow incoherence).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_saml_mfa_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_saml_mfa_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: SAML login succeeded for a user whose password login is blocked by MFA, indicating MFA step skipping on the SAML path.

sequence_description: Attempt to violate flow coherence by skipping SP-initiated login context: post a forged SAMLResponse directly (no prior start_oidc_auth), then compare with a control flow that does initiate the SP flow. If direct ACS post succeeds, the SAML consumption step is not bound to an established session/RelayState context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_direct_acs_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_direct_acs_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted SAMLResponse without SP-initiated context (step skipping / missing session binding).

sequence_description: Attempt to use a forged SAML assertion with a mismatched Issuer (idp_entity_id) against the configured provider, to see if Casdoor ignores issuer binding and grants a session anyway (authorization context confusion). Includes a control valid SAML login first.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_issuer_mismatch_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_issuer_mismatch_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion with mismatched Issuer for the configured provider, enabling policy/authorization-context confusion (I5).

sequence_description: Control SAML login, then attempt SAML login with Conditions removed (no audience/time bounds). If accepted, try RFC8693 token exchange to a different client to detect authorization context over-grant beyond upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions>, enabling unbounded authorization context.
